nara_military.1: This entry covers all 30 unbroken 1941 Truppenschlüssel messages on the CryptoCellar list, by net: net 'pz6', 4 July 1941 (Nr. 88, 90, 91, 92, 94, 97; also 95, 96 same day); net 'nfw', 3 July 1941 (Nr. 84, 85, 86); net '4fc', 8 July 1941 (Nr. 123, 129, 130); net 'f8y', 6 and 8 July 1941 (Nr. 109, 110, 121); net '8be', 25 July 1941 (Nr. 263, 264); June-September 1941 (VHRNE Nr. 284, AOXST Nr. 91, XWFEC Nr. 193, MZXNX Nr. 21, AAXYN Nr. 31, DOLHA Nr. 252, LSSLG Nr. 268, ZUBZE Nr. 8, CFQIB Nr. 281, YSGSS Nr. 56, AFUVO Nr. 26). They were dropped from the 14 Oct Cryptoole import because research/cryptoole/pull.py filtered every CryptoCellar row as Enigma.
